UI13 independent computer file transfers remain A6 on Android. iOS upstream implementation is retained but physical transfer delivery is not claimed by this gate.
Synthetic recognition, notifications, providers, release signing, real execution, OIDC/public relay and physical devices are not verified by this gate. Xiaomi physical tests remain paused.
